title: Peace upon Noah; Abraham Questions His People

paragraphs.text: The earlier peoples who were warned came to a bad end, but this was not the case for the chosen servants of Allah. They are named again as an exception, just as they were named before.

Noah once called out to Allah for help, and Allah is the best of those who answer. He saved Noah and his family from the great distress that came upon them. He made Noah's descendants the ones who remained on the earth after that, and He left for him a good name among the later generations. Then come the words, "Peace upon Noah among the worlds." Allah says that this is how He rewards those who do good, because Noah was one of His believing servants. After saving Noah and his family, Allah drowned the others, the people who had disbelieved.

Abraham was among those who were of the same kind as Noah. He came to his Lord with a sound heart. He asked his father and his people, "What do you worship?" He asked them whether they really wanted false gods other than Allah, which were only a lie. Then he asked them, "What do you think about the Lord of the worlds?" After that, Abraham took a look at the stars and said that he was about to become ill. So his people turned away from him and left, departing from him, while he stayed behind. What he did after they left is told in the next verses.
